name: Point Medical Corporation
old_description: Point Medical specializes in the custom development and fabrication of implant grade silicone rubber devices and assemblies that meet the exacting tolerances and specifications required for the medical environment.
about:
Point Medical Corporation operates from Crown Point, Indiana, where it develops and fabricates implant-grade silicone rubber devices and assemblies for medical applications. The company focuses on custom development and fabrication to meet exacting tolerances and specifications required in the medical environment.

The facility is FDA-registered and ISO 13485:2016 certified, with a Class 10,000 clean room. In-house prototype development and tooling accelerate the transition to production. Capabilities span extrusion (custom, multi-lumen, co-extrusion, miniature profiles, wire-reinforced, striped, close-tolerance, translucent, radiopaque), catheter assembly (smooth transition tube-to-lumen molding, balloons, coil forming, printing, complete fabrication, latex-to-silicone conversion), molding (liquid injection, top transfer, compression, insert), and tipping (forming, clean-cut holes, step cutting, taper and bullet tips).

Point Medical serves medical device manufacturers and clinical consultants, providing custom silicone rubber components for applications such as catheters, tubing, and implantable assemblies. The company also operates Martech Medical Products for non-silicone plastics manufacturing.

The company emphasizes an ongoing inquiry into the latest technology, materials, and manufacturing methods to ensure custom product performance. Its reputation for quality and innovative design stems from consistent attention to materials, machining, and manufacturing techniques.
